title: GIS and LiDAR Engineer
description:
Required Skills: Knowledge of LiDAR data processing and GIS. Working knowledge of ArcGIS Pro / QGIS and MicroStation (TerraScan / TerraModeler). Understanding of point cloud classification (Ground, Buildings, Vegetation and Water). Knowledge of DTM/DSM generation and 2D/3D feature extraction. Basic understanding of coordinate systems and spatial data. 

This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

Key Skills: Processing,Arcgis PRO,Classification,Data processing,DSM,GIS,Process,Lidar
